paite: Ka tapa, ka thute na san a, ka thupiakte nang a na kholkhawmleh;
heading: Pilna Kipahmante

paite: huchi a pilna lam a na bil na doh a, theihsiamna lam a na lung na suk leh;
ahi, theihkakna na sap a, theihsiamna ding a na aw na suahleh;
dangka bang a huai na zon a, gou sel bang a huai na zonleh;
huchi in TOUPA kihtakna na theisiam ding a, Pathian theihna na mu ding hi.
TOUPA'N lah pilna ape ngal a; akam a kipan in theihna leh theihsiamna ahong pai hi.
Midik a ding in pilna hoih akholkhawm a, muanhuaina a omte amaute a ding in lum ahi.
Vaihawmna lampite aventheihna ding in, amisiangthoute lampi ahawitheihna ding in.
Huchi in diktatna leh vaihawmna na theisiam ding a, huan, hawmsiamna, ahi, lampi hoih chiteng.
Na lungtang sung ah pilna ahong lut ding a, huan na kha a ding in theihna anuam ding hi.
Ngentelna in nang ahon veng ding a, theihsiamna in nang ahon kem ding hi.
Gilou lampi a kipan ahon hunkhe ding, mi thil hoih lou gente a kipan;
lampi tangte mangngilh, khomial lampite a pai ding;
gilou hih ding a kipak a, gilou hoihlouhna a nuamsa;
alampite ua kawi a, alampite ua dikloute.
Numei lamdang a kipan nang hon hun ding, mikhualnu athute toh amaitangphatnu a kipan mahmah in;
ama'n atuailai lawm anusia a, a Pathian thukhun amangngilh hi.
A-inn in sihna lampi adoh a, alampite'n misite lampi;
amah kiang a hoh kuamah akik nawn kei ua, kuamah in hinna lampite aphazou sam kei uhi.
Mihoihte lampi a na pai theih a, midiktatte lampi na zuihtheihna ding in.
Mitangte gamsung a teng ding ahi ua, huan asung ah mihoihkimte a-om tawntung ding uh.
Himahleh giloute gam a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding ua, huan lepchiahtak a hihte huai a kipan zungkalhkhiak in a-om ding uh.
